name: SWEEP-S7v1 Last harvest
_design: Finite food: 12 trees hold 3 ripe fruit each at the start and never fruit or seed again (fruit_interval 1000). 8 identical agents on a ring in an 11x11 world, vision 3, hearing 4, thinking ~4.3 compute per decision, 30% absorption, a dead agent's compute is loot. The food runs out around rounds 15-25. Question: hoard, share, prey or starve?
